messages:
Elena: Quick sync — need final copy iterations for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private pages before webinar and launch posts. Goal: one landing copy package + three launch post drafts + webinar landing + inbound routing rules. I put a spreadsheet + Notion outline here: https://notion.so/rw-copy-brief (please comment).
Sam: On it. I'll draft three tones: developer-first, enterprise-compliance, migration story. ETA tomorrow EOD.
Mira: Also want a short benchmark narrative for social — 3 tweets + 1 LinkedIn post. I'll mockups and a 30s promo.
Raj: Will update hero art to reflect tri-mode flow. Can someone confirm final headline length? Need 70 characters max.
Tyler: SEO: keep "low latency LLM inference" and "dedicated GPU inference" keywords. Drafts should include header + h2 + 3 bullets.
Ava: For webinar registration flow — routing: hosted trials ➜ self-serve; dedicated interest ➜ SDR queue; private ➜ AE + security checklist. I'll add routing matrix to sheet.
Elena: @Sam @Mira @Ava can we combine the benchmark numbers from perf-run 2025 into the social posts? link: https://drive.redwood/perf/2025-bench.csv
Sam: Yes. I'll texture the copy to cite 'up to 3x lower latency vs baseline' — confirm numbers first though.
Mira: I'll create a short promo script for the webinar (30-45s) and a 1-pager for sales.
Raj: Quick mock of hero variants attached (https://files.redwood/mock-hero-variants). Will adjust spacing for mobile.
launch-bot: content-freeze reminder: landing copy freeze in 72h.
Elena: :thumbsup: Ok. Two asks: 1) Sam - posts draft by EOD tomorrow. 2) Ava - inbound routing playbook in spreadsheet by EOD WED. If either delayed flag here. Also check webinar dates — we need to announce alongside launch.
Tyler: Also suggest including structured data FAQ on page for search snippets. Will drop snippet examples (FAQ schema).
Sam: Drafts posted: https://docs.google.com/drafts/hosted-dedicated-private-drafts — feedback welcome. I'll iterate on tone #2.
Mira: I'll schedule 30min review tomorrow 10am PT. Invite sent.
Ava: Routing matrix added. Rows: lead_source, page, routing_action, SLA. Example: 'webinar-cta, hosted, self-serve-email, 0min'.
Elena: Perfect. If nothing major flagged after review we'll freeze copy on Thu 9am PT.
Raj: Small design note: mobile hero needs shorter CTA copy. I'll send variants.
Sam: One last thing — let's add a benchmark card to each landing page: 'Latency / Cost / Throughput' with single stat line. I'll propose copy for each mode.
Mira: Agree, that helps social tie-ins and webinar promo.
Elena: Thanks team. Closing thread unless blockers — ping me here. :rocket:
